message: Refreshing a token returns a new refresh token and revokes the one that was used
bullet_points: POST /api/user/token-refresh/ now also returns refresh_token and user_session. Use the new refresh token for the next refresh.
The previous refresh token stops working after 30 seconds, and using it after that signs the whole session off.
Set BASEROW_ROTATE_REFRESH_TOKENS=false to keep the previous behaviour.
